notes.title: Update to fix world 3 and reduce adverts.
notes.notes:
Beekyr (Vanilla) edition has just updated to 1.3.18.

- I have just fixed World 3 that didn't work well with the previous water effect. Now the effect is static and it works pretty well.

- Also I have reduced the amount of ads that the player will see. Plus, if you own Beekyr Reloaded you won't see any ads from that game. And same thing happens to Vortex Attack ads.

Enjoy!!!
